rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for the area by the sea.

example.english: The weather is so nice today; let’s go swimming by the seaside.
example.traditional: 今日天氣咁好，我哋去海邊游水啦。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 gam3 hou2 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 hoi2 bin1 jau4 seoi2 laa1

rows.note: Use this especially for an urban waterfront or seafront promenade rather than a beach or open coast in general.

example.english: The night view along this seaside promenade is beautiful.
example.traditional: 呢條海旁長廊夜景好靚。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 hoi2 pong4 coeng4 long4 je6 ging2 hou2 leng3
